# PropertyOS GitHub Discussions

## Approved categories

| Category | Slug | Format | Creation authority |
|---|---|---|---|
| Announcements | `announcements` | Announcement | Maintainers |
| Ideas | `ideas` | Open-ended | Community |
| Q&A | `q-and-a` | Question and answer | Community |
| Architecture | `architecture` | Open-ended | Community |
| Plugins | `plugins` | Open-ended | Community |
| Themes | `themes` | Open-ended | Community |
| AI | `ai` | Open-ended | Community |
| Documentation | `documentation` | Open-ended | Community |
| Community | `community` | Open-ended | Community |

## Governance

- GitHub Discussions must be enabled by a repository administrator.
- Category names and slugs must match the corresponding files under
  `.github/DISCUSSION_TEMPLATE/`.
- Announcements are created only by maintainers.
- Security vulnerabilities must never be posted publicly.
- Product ideas do not authorize implementation.
- Architectural discussions do not replace ADR or governance approval.
- All participation is governed by `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`.
- Support boundaries are governed by `SUPPORT.md`.
- Product freeze remains active during Repository Foundation.

## Activation checklist

1. Enable GitHub Discussions in repository settings.
2. Create the approved categories with the exact slugs above.
3. Use the prescribed category formats.
4. Verify each structured Discussion form renders.
5. Confirm announcement creation is restricted to maintainers.
6. Pin a welcome discussion and community guidance.
7. Confirm security reports route privately.
